g.text: Search with expansion: Ollama unavailable or too slow (fallback)
and the in-flight limit as on the happy path
the next request for this query
last start at least RECOVERY_INTERVAL ago
a failed expansion starts a background
warm-up (timeout 30 s, at most one per 30 s);
after a connection failure the next attempt
a cold model can finish loading:
No error reaches the client: an unavailable Ollama only removes the expansion.
SearchSocket also catches a RuntimeException from expand() and uses [] (defensive; expand() does not throw).
